context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements document previews using SwiftUI .quickLookPreview, multi-file QLPreviewController, and asynchronous QLThumbnailGenerator with NSCache.

checklist.name: SwiftUI QuickLook Preview
checklist.description: Utilizes the .quickLookPreview($url) modifier bound to an optional local URL in SwiftUI.

checklist.name: QLThumbnailGenerator Pipeline
checklist.description: Configures QLThumbnailGenerator.Request with target size, scale, and fetches best representations asynchronously.

checklist.name: Thumbnail Caching & Performance
checklist.description: Caches loaded thumbnails with NSCache to avoid repetitive disk decodes and performs generation asynchronously.

checklist.name: QLPreviewController & Multi-File Data Source
checklist.description: Implements QLPreviewControllerDataSource to support multi-file carousels with custom QLPreviewItem models.

checklist.name: Local File Handling & Remote Cleanup
checklist.description: Highlights that QuickLook requires local file URLs, handling temporary storage and cleanup for remote downloads.
